defects.summary: Clicking the front sleeve does not open the album for a user: only a strip about 5px tall responds, 4% of the visible art at 1280 and 2% at 390. browser.mjs passed by clicking only that strip.
defects.cause: .crate is a transparent flat plane in front of the rotated sleeve and takes the hit. Injecting .crate{pointer-events:none}.crate>*{pointer-events:auto} gave a hit range across the whole art at both commits.
